svg.title: Transactions redesign, concept A: Ledger
svg.desc: Dense ledger layout for the Transactions page: summary strip, inline 32px toolbar, single-line rows with account and label columns, thin sticky day dividers with day net, infinite scroll footer. Desktop, mobile, mobile filter sheet, and loading, empty, error and end-of-range states.
